propositions: BindingStore 799-line module owns byte persistence, lifecycle policy, retirement, recovery, and peer-state delegation without cohesive internal structure, creating safety and maintainability risks.
Production code mutates inner entries returned by shallow all_bindings() query, violating encapsulation and enabling uncontrolled state changes.
Retirement intent must be durable and authoritative: a tombstone with forward and reverse agreement is removed only on explicit unretire, never by automatic liveness observation.

Recovery operations must run after staleness validation but before remote issue fetch, and must complete exact-match interrupted retirements idempotently without enabling resurrection via automatic signals.

Decomposition must preserve all existing serialization format, unknown fields, byte-exact compatibility, selective five-file publication, and shallow all_bindings() behavior through unified public facade.
